about: Hand-kept evidence behind docs/validation/release_status.md (regenerate it with tools/metrics/gen_release_status.py). One entry per catalogue metric key. 'verified' = the code is unit-tested AND the reading was checked on real swings (one-swing re-run, frame sheet or library consistency check). 'validated' = compared against an independent reference (a device, hand-marked frames, an instrumented club or worn sensors) with the agreement measured. 'syntheticOnly' = tested only against a simulated body or signal. Record the date, the evidence and where it is written up. Never mark validated without a measured agreement against a reference.

validated.note: Launch-monitor readings are the reference: graded as the device reports them.
HackMotion is the criterion instrument for the lead wrist; its readings are taken as the reference.
Camera clubhead speed against the launch monitor: bias about −1.7, limits of agreement narrowed from ±20 to ±10 (memory: clubhead-speed-vs-lm-agreement).
Shaft lean σ calibrated: 63 % / 90 % coverage at 1σ / 2σ, bias +0.7° (docs/design/shaft_uncertainty_propagation_design.md).

verified.evidence: One-swing re-run before and after the 3-D shoulder fix (Chris −26.1° → −11.9°, Mark −24.9° → −3.0°) and two library sweeps.
Re-fit on real swings after the cross-view shoulder fix; the fit's shoulder line agrees with the down-the-line image to 0.1–1.6°.

syntheticOnly.note: The chest-sensor route is tested on a simulated body only; needs the worn session (#109).

verified.evidence: Frame sheet (4 July swing 8): the down-the-line reading matches the visible knee at impact; the uncalibrated 3-D fit does not, so the camera stays the answer.
One-swing check: the 3-D route reads 20.1° at impact against 19.9° down the line.
Face-on elbow fold after impact: frame sheet of four flagged swings showed all four were occlusion artefacts; the visibility gate now refuses them. Library audit: 217 of 244 swings gradeable.
Frame sheet (Jess against Nick, 20 Oct): the down-the-line image angle reproduces what the eye sees; the 3-D gap was mostly a steep 3-D shoulder line.
Frame sheet (Mark 4 July, 7 and 8 Oct): lines reproduce the stored values, but the reading moves with the down-the-line camera's set-up; it carries a camera warning until calibration.
The takeaway (plane at P2 − address) is steady across four camera set-ups (Mark −2.6 to −4.0°) and predicts the hand-path loop within a session (ρ −0.51, 168 swings).
One-swing check; the P2-outside / top-laid-off pair is the signature of the uncalibrated down-the-line camera's turn, so it carries ±9°.
